title: Inheritance, Interfaces and Design
description: Reusing and abstracting behavior: inheritance, overriding versus overloading, abstract classes, interfaces with default methods, composition over inheritance, two SOLID principles, functional interfaces and anonymous classes, records, and the singleton and factory patterns.
